messages:
anya: Quick note from an afternoon usability pass: pricing page shows heavy mouse dwell in the slab calculator but almost no CTA clicks. heatmap: https://redwood-internal/hm/5001. Thinking a very lightweight micro-offer to capture intent (no full demo).

marco: Metrics?

anya: impressions ~3.8k, calc CTA CTR 1.5%, hover->click ~13:1, median dwell 3.4s. Many repeat hovers in same session.

tess: Sounds like interest without confidence. Idea: an inline ‘sprout’ card that appears after the second long hover with two tiny choices: “Quick cost check” or “Join short pricing clinic”. Both are 1-2 field flows (email + company size).

sales-ops: Routing suggestion: if clinic chosen AND size >= 150 -> route to SDR queue "pricing-sprout-fast" (24h SLA). If quick check -> send nurture with automated cost snapshot email. Tag lead with variant.

tracking-bot: Required events: rw_sprout_hover, rw_sprout_shown, rw_sprout_choice, rw_sprout_submit. Please include calc_session_id and page_variant.

marco: I can add GTM events and a tiny dashboard for conversion and contact time. Will pref‍ill email for logged-in users.

anya: Tess, can you draft two succinct micro-copy variants and the clinic blurb (1 line) by EOD? Marco, add events + dashboard by tomorrow AM. Sales-ops, build the HubSpot workflow and SLA by tomorrow noon. Tracking-bot, confirm payload includes calc_session_id and auth_email.

tess: Draft copy: (clinic) "Join a 25-min pricing clinic — practical examples, real numbers, Q&A" CTA: "Reserve clinic"; (check) "Get a quick cost check for your workload" CTA: "Get cost check". Will post refinements in #marketing. :seedling:
